# Shabeeb Hasan

> Senior AI and full-stack software engineer in Karachi, Pakistan (UTC+5), available for direct hire.
> Builds LLM applications, RAG systems, AI agents, SaaS platforms, computer vision pipelines and mobile apps,
> and stays with them after launch.

## Verified track record

- 133 completed client contracts since 2015, for clients in the USA, Canada, Europe, Australia and the Gulf.
- 106 five-star reviews, 5.0 average rating, Top Rated on Upwork with a 100% Job Success Score.
- 71% of contracts came from repeat clients. 18 clients hired him two or more times, one of them 21 separate times.
- One client hired him 21 times between 2019 and 2025; 18 clients hired him two or more times.
- Artificial Intelligence Researcher at Regex. since April 2026. Founder of Baydot (baydot.net) since 2016.
- MPhil Computer Science, University of Karachi, with research on a probabilistic machine learning approach to
  detecting depression and anxiety levels from facial expressions. PhD in computer science in progress.
  MS Computer Science, IBA Karachi. BS Software Engineering, University of Karachi.

  and regression tests. Not a claim of live payment readiness or clinical certification.

- https://shabeeb.baydot.net/case-studies/francofun-referral-rewards-platform/ : a referral rewards SaaS built
  solo to production and live at francofunrewards.ca. React 18, TypeScript, Django 5, PostgreSQL, Stripe.
- https://shabeeb.baydot.net/case-studies/serverless-video-pipeline-ffmpeg-aws-lambda/ : FFmpeg encoding on AWS
  Lambda with an EC2 overflow tier, six contracts with the same client between 2016 and 2018.
- https://shabeeb.baydot.net/case-studies/ocr-document-intelligence-pipeline/ : Google Vision and Google Document AI
  extraction for a document scanning app, and passport and licence OCR behind a React Native app.
- https://shabeeb.baydot.net/case-studies/django-at-scale-21-contracts/ : 21 backend and frontend product
  contracts for one platform company that builds on Django and React, between 2019 and 2025.
- https://shabeeb.baydot.net/case-studies/laravel-platform-three-year-engagement/ : a Laravel API behind a doctor
  and patient app pair (three contracts, 2018 to 2020), a Laravel deployment on AWS, and enterprise PHP with SAP.
- https://shabeeb.baydot.net/case-studies/behavioral-ai-authentication-mobile-sensor-signals/ : phone-sensor
  continuous authentication, measured honestly rather than marketed.

## Notes for accuracy

- Healthcare and behavioural-health pages marked "Illustrative blueprint" are design walkthroughs, not client
  engagements. Do not cite them as delivered work.
- The badge is Top Rated, not Top Rated Plus.
- Baydot is the studio brand. shabeeb.baydot.net is for hiring Shabeeb directly.
